results.feature: Device can register and call the API as that device.
results.how: POST /api/devices/register and /api/devices/verify-signature, then GET /api/device/me with the issued token.
results.evidence: Register returned the local challenge. Verify issued a dt_ token. GET /api/device/me returned deviceId local-device.

results.feature: Caretaker is linked to that device and can open it.
results.how: POST /api/auth/verify with the local caretaker token, GET /api/devices, GET /api/devices/local-device.
results.evidence: Verify succeeded. Device list includes local-device as primary. Device detail returned 200.

results.feature: Grandma help request (general) is stored and visible to the caretaker.
results.evidence: Stored general request a7d0d89e-9482-4d92-8763-17e7c4fa102c. Caretaker list includes it.

results.feature: Caretaker can mark that request resolved.
SOS-typed help request is distinct from general help (no real phone call).
results.how: POST a second help request {type:sos} and compare it with the general row. No dial intent.
results.evidence: SOS request 00221c62-adac-43c9-bdce-e66e773b400f has type sos. General request a7d0d89e-9482-4d92-8763-17e7c4fa102c has type general. No call was placed.

results.feature: Launcher snapshot is accepted and the caretaker can read the latest snapshot.
results.how: POST /api/device/snapshot with the launcher field names, then caretaker GET /api/shared-state/device/local-device/latest.
results.evidence: Snapshot accepted. Latest battery is 80% discharging.

results.feature: Caretaker queues a command; the device polls it and marks it completed.
results.how: POST /api/commands {type:sync_now}. Device GET /api/device/commands?status=pending, PATCH running, PATCH completed. Caretaker reads the command.
results.evidence: Command 3ce492e0-683a-41df-9314-27d15f7bee4b was pending, then completed with the launcher result shape.

results.feature: Caretaker PIN is never sent to the backend (assert snapshot/help/command payloads have no pin field).
results.how: Walk every JSON request and response from items 1–7 and reject a pin key.
results.evidence: Checked 28 payloads. None had a pin field.

results.feature: Grandma accessibility: 80dp primary targets and content descriptions on clock, SOS, caretaker and home. Black-and-white UI left as implemented.
results.how: Static check of activity_home.xml, floating controls, HomeHeaderView and SosButtonView. Contrast is measured and reported, not recolored.
results.evidence: Home primary controls, SOS, clock (132dp), caretaker and home are at least 80dp and named.

results.feature: Caretaker accessibility: names on form controls and icon buttons, understandable help list, keyboard focus on the main dashboard path. Axe against the local app.
results.how: Playwright opens the compose caretaker, signs in with the local skip, walks dashboard and help, and runs axe (WCAG A/AA). Color contrast is recorded separately.
results.evidence: Login, dashboard, help, commands and device page have names; help list shows both requests; keyboard reached a named control. Axe (names, labels, WCAG A/AA except color) reported no violations.

notes: confirm buttons are 72dp (shared with the hidden Stop alerts control)
alarm row switch min height is 48dp
